claims.event: Liu Yao is introduced with native place Mouping in Donglai, rescues his uncle at nineteen, holds local posts, becomes Inspector of Yang Province, fights Yuan Shu, Sun Ce and Ze Rong, and dies at forty-two.

Served as Palace Attendant and Inspector of Yan Province; praised in the Record of Heroes.

Yuan Shu occupied Huainan, plotted usurpation, appointed his own Inspector of Yang Province and attacked Liu Yao's generals for over a year.

Ze Rong of Danyang served Tao Qian, built Buddhist shrines, killed Zhao Yu, Xue Li and Zhu Hao, was defeated by Liu Yao and killed by commoners.
